name: Shirasagi no Naku Koro ni
source:
Main character comes to distant relatives house in the mountains for the White day, but decides to stay and live there afterwards. What secrets does this hidden mansion hold? Will protagonist choose reason or desire?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角来到远方的山里亲戚家里过白色情人节，但之后决定留下来住在那里。这座隐藏的豪宅到底隐藏着什么秘密？主角会选择理性还是欲望？
